definitions.explanation: A felt-padded eraser used to wipe chalk off a blackboard. A familiar object in Japanese classrooms.

examples.english: I erased the writing with the blackboard eraser.

examples.japanese: {黒板|こくばん}{拭|ふ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧だ。
examples.english: The blackboard eraser is covered in chalk dust.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{黒板|こくばん}{拭|ふ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧にした。
examples.english: After class, I cleaned the blackboard eraser by clapping it outside the window.

notes:
A felt-padded eraser for wiping chalk off a blackboard. A familiar object in Japanese classrooms, where students often clean them by clapping the dust out.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒板|こくばん}{拭|ふ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: to erase with a blackboard eraser
- {黒板|こくばん}{拭|ふ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧: to clap the chalk dust out of the eraser

USAGE:
Also called ⟦{黒板消|こくばんけ}し→黒板消し：24875_kokubankeshi⟧, which is the more common term in some regions.
